products.name: Google Vertex AI
products.note: Unified ML platform; Model Garden; AutoML; MLOps lifecycle; BigQuery integration; TPU support

profile_text.body:
Google Cloud is the cloud computing division of Google, operating under the publicly traded parent company with ticker GOOGL (CIK 0001652044). The company describes itself as offering AI and cloud computing services covering security, data management, and hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Its site presents an ecosystem of products aimed at both businesses and developers, including a Gemini product line with an offering called Gemini Enterprise, and an Agent Platform described as a fully managed AI development platform that provides access to Agent Studio and over 200 foundation models for building and managing AI applications and agents.

The primary AI product tracked for Google Cloud is Google Vertex AI, a unified machine learning platform that incorporates a Model Garden, AutoML capabilities, MLOps lifecycle tooling, BigQuery integration, and TPU support. The site also highlights generative AI use cases in retail, citing Best Buy as a customer that uses Google Cloud generative AI to power virtual assistants handling customer care tasks such as troubleshooting product issues, managing order delivery and schedules, and managing subscriptions.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server listings for Google Cloud. The company holds a verified page on theworldofai.org and is classified as a for-profit public company.
